title: Wack 100 Sounds Off-On Charleston White & Soulja Boy's Altercation
htmlContent:
Just two days after YouTuber Charleston White claimed that he and his team macerated Soulja Boy, the rapper "Crank Dat" picked up on social media on Friday to set the record straight.

“If I knew that you n**** was gon’ get on the internet, talk all of this gangsta s***, all of this crazy s***, and reach in your girl purse and start spraying pepper spray in the air running, n****, like it’s a trail, n****, running with pepper spray, what the f***!” he said.

Soulja then phoned Charleston and his team for pulling pepper spray on him, saying, “You n***** so scared of me, y’all n***as gotta pull pepper spray out your bitch’s purse? Running with pepper spray? What the f***?”

He added, “I thought you n***as was gangsta. N***** pulling out pepper spray and doing the dashboard. N****, stop talking about Big Draco. N****, stop saying my name, n****. Got you n***** pulling out pepper spray and doing the dash, n****.”

As reported by XXL, Charleston revealed during an Instagram Live chat on Friday that he macerated Soulja and her team during a showdown in Miami.

“They don’t know if they’d been tased,” White said. “They don’t know what happened to that.”

“I hit they muthaf****’ ass one more time just for goodness sake. [Soulja Boy] said, ‘Bruh, you maced me?’ Yeah, n**** … That n**** said, ‘I just wanna talk.’ … Next time you n***** better holla with a bullhorn. You better use the police bullhorn and say, ‘Hey, we wanna talk.’ Other than that, shit, you can’t just walk up to a n**** like me hollerin’ about you wanna talk. I don’t wanna talk to nan son of a bitch. Hell nah … What if he hit me across my head with one of them rings, put that eye out?”

Well, it didn't take long for Wack 100 to chime in on the situation on Clubhouse. On Saturday night, he was asked about the incident.

"Let me tell you who Charleston White is! This is why I stopped even going at Charleston White.

Charleston White is the Eminem of blogs. You know how Eminem talked about himself, and he talked about his own family to where you couldn't diss him. He dissed himself. He took your weapon from you, so what you were going to do. You got you was going out rapping make a song for a song he was cool with that you could not make a dis song on Eminem because it wasn't going to matter," said Wack 100.

"Charleston White tell you that I'm team snitch. He will call the police on live so what are you going to do?... He will never get another bag of water out of me. You're really giving him what he want, which is Charleston White goes out with Wack 100. He won that's all."

Wack is trying to say that the minute his name is mentioned with Charleston White, White's name is trending because, in this case, Soulja took the bait. Just like Wack did a couple of months ago.
